title: A Waiver node record
description: A Waiver node record. The digest covers the waiver document — its justification and expiry live in that document, not here — and carries the document's source location (SEG-SREQ-050).

id.description: An absolute IRI minted at serialization time. Opaque: its parts are never split back out, because a part may itself contain the separator (ADR-0007).

seg:localId.description: The case-local stable identifier — the string that enters a hash preimage. The id above is its serialization, not a second identity.

seg:contentHashSource.description: Where the content behind seg:contentHash lives (SEG-SREQ-050). A reference for transient fetch, never integrity data: no part of a source location enters a hash preimage.

seg:sourceLocator.description: A waiver is a document; the digest always covers the whole file at the path, so 'file' is the only span there is to name.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest, lowercase hex, exactly 64 characters. SHA-256 is fixed for the whole graph, so the digest needs no algorithm beside it (ADR-0005).

sourceRepo.description: The repository holding the content this digest covers.

sourcePath.description: The path within the repository to the file holding the content.
